title: Rclone 1.51.0 before 1.76.0 Authentication Bypass via serve sftp Auth-Proxy Cache (CVE-2026-134352)
description: Rclone versions from 1.51.0 up to but not including 1.76.0 contain an authentication bypass vulnerability in the serve sftp --auth-proxy feature. The vulnerability arises because the cache key used for authentication does not include the authentication method, allowing attackers who know a victim's base64 public key to reuse cached authentication entries from the same client IP and gain unauthorized read-write access to the virtual file system. This issue is fixed in version 1.76.0.
